SELECT
	thrs_data.timestamp          AS time,
	metadata.device              AS device,
	thrs_data.temperature__value AS temperature
FROM public.marpower__thrs__temperatures AS thrs_data
JOIN (
	SELECT
		mqtt_topic,
		regexp_replace(mqtt_topic, 'marpower/500000-thrs/([^/]+)/.*$', '$1')                              AS "section",
		concat('[', yard_tag, '] ', regexp_replace(mqtt_topic, 'marpower/500000-thrs/.*/([^/]+)$', '$1')) AS device
	FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
	WHERE mqtt_json_path = '$.Temperature'
) AS metadata
ON thrs_data.topic = metadata.mqtt_topic
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
AND metadata."section" IN (${section:sqlstring})
ORDER BY device, time ASC
